inventory_scope: Human documents .md/.txt/.rst and structured/log .json/.jsonl/.log/.yaml/.yml/.toml; all matched file contents read and SHA256 computed; no Python source or binaries are claimed line-by-line reviewed.
warning_epoch_total_not_independent_runs: Snapshots/continuations can overlap without identical full-file hashes; no sum is a count of independently executed training.
exclusions: Hidden dirs/files (.git/.ssh/.config etc), symlinks, known secret filenames, node_modules/site/site-packages/wheels/vendor/cache/images; binary weights/images/archives/PDF; this audit output. No external tool logs outside work.
limitations: Filesystem inventory is not atomic; active new student logs may change after snapshot.
All included bytes were accessed mechanically; headings/scalars/exception extraction is not a claim of manual line-by-line review or causal validation.
Missing/disappeared temp files and outside-work local state are not reconstructed.
A history line is recorded-complete epoch evidence; an interrupted next epoch is not counted.
Duplicate history hashes identify exact copies only; nonidentical continuations and mechanical smokes are not independent full experiments.
Status failure may reflect user STOP/recoverable reporting errors; logs and stop receipts must decide interpretation.
